56d14ca7878d.patch:81: +usage() {
56d14ca7878d.patch:82: +  cat >&2 <<EOF

56d14ca7878d.patch:84: +
56d14ca7878d.patch:85: +Canonical flux-check entry point.
56d14ca7878d.patch:86: +
56d14ca7878d.patch:87: +Options:
56d14ca7878d.patch:88: +  --all                    Run flux on all crates with flux annotations
56d14ca7878d.patch:89: +  --crates P1 [P2 ...]    Run flux on specific packages
56d14ca7878d.patch:90: +  --dry-run               Print commands without executing
56d14ca7878d.patch:91: +  --help                  Show this help message
56d14ca7878d.patch:92: +
56d14ca7878d.patch:93: +When --all or --crates is omitted, the first positional argument is treated
56d14ca7878d.patch:94: +as the package name. Additional positional arguments are forwarded to
56d14ca7878d.patch:95: +cargo-flux.
56d14ca7878d.patch:96: +EOF
56d14ca7878d.patch:97:    exit 2
56d14ca7878d.patch:98: -fi
56d14ca7878d.patch:99: +}

56d14ca7878d.patch:101: +# --- Argument parsing ---
56d14ca7878d.patch:102: +dry_run=false
56d14ca7878d.patch:103: +run_all=false
56d14ca7878d.patch:104: +declare -a extra_packages=()

56d14ca7878d.patch:106: +
56d14ca7878d.patch:107: +while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do

56d14ca7878d.patch:111: +      ;;
56d14ca7878d.patch:112: +    --dry-run)
56d14ca7878d.patch:113: +      dry_run=true
56d14ca7878d.patch:114: +      shift
56d14ca7878d.patch:115: +      ;;
56d14ca7878d.patch:116: +    --all)
56d14ca7878d.patch:117: +      run_all=true
56d14ca7878d.patch:118: +      shift
56d14ca7878d.patch:119: +      ;;
56d14ca7878d.patch:120: +    --crates)
56d14ca7878d.patch:121: +      shift
56d14ca7878d.patch:122: +      if [ "$#" -lt 1 ]; then
56d14ca7878d.patch:123: +        printf 'error: --crates requires at least one package name\n' >&2
56d14ca7878d.patch:124: +        exit 2
56d14ca7878d.patch:125: +      fi
56d14ca7878d.patch:126: +      while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do
56d14ca7878d.patch:127: +        case "$1" in
56d14ca7878d.patch:128: +          --dry-run|--all|--crates|--help)
56d14ca7878d.patch:129: +            break
56d14ca7878d.patch:130: +            ;;
56d14ca7878d.patch:131: +          *)
56d14ca7878d.patch:132: +            extra_packages+=("$1")
56d14ca7878d.patch:133: +            shift
56d14ca7878d.patch:134: +            ;;
56d14ca7878d.patch:135: +        esac
56d14ca7878d.patch:136: +      done
56d14ca7878d.patch:137: +      ;;
56d14ca7878d.patch:138: +    *)
56d14ca7878d.patch:139: +      flux_args+=("$1")
56d14ca7878d.patch:140: +      shift
56d14ca7878d.patch:141: +      ;;

56d14ca7878d.patch:143: +done

56d14ca7878d.patch:149: +reject_target_selector() {

56d14ca7878d.patch:166: +# --- Discover packages ---
56d14ca7878d.patch:167: +discover_all_flux_crates() {
56d14ca7878d.patch:168: +  # Find crates with #[cfg(flux)] gated flux source files.
56d14ca7878d.patch:169: +  # This avoids running flux on every crate when only a subset has annotations.
56d14ca7878d.patch:170: +  local found=()
56d14ca7878d.patch:171: +  for manifest in "$WORKSPACE_ROOT"/crates/*/Cargo.toml; do
56d14ca7878d.patch:172: +    local crate_name
56d14ca7878d.patch:173: +    crate_name="$(basename "$(dirname "$manifest")")"
56d14ca7878d.patch:174: +    # Check if the crate has flux-annotated source files
56d14ca7878d.patch:175: +    local crate_src="$WORKSPACE_ROOT/crates/$crate_name/src"
56d14ca7878d.patch:176: +    if [ -d "$crate_src" ] && grep -rl '#\[cfg(flux)\]' "$crate_src" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
56d14ca7878d.patch:177: +      found+=("$crate_name")
56d14ca7878d.patch:178: +    fi
56d14ca7878d.patch:179: +  done
56d14ca7878d.patch:180: +  printf '%s\n' "${found[@]+"${found[@]}"}"
56d14ca7878d.patch:181: +}
56d14ca7878d.patch:182: +
56d14ca7878d.patch:183: +if $run_all; then
56d14ca7878d.patch:184: +  declare -a packages=()
56d14ca7878d.patch:185: +  while IFS= read -r pkg; do
56d14ca7878d.patch:186: +    [ -n "$pkg" ] && packages+=("$pkg")
56d14ca7878d.patch:187: +  done < <(discover_all_flux_crates)
56d14ca7878d.patch:188: +elif [ "${#extra_packages[@]}" -gt 0 ]; then
56d14ca7878d.patch:189: +  packages=("${extra_packages[@]}")
56d14ca7878d.patch:190: +else
56d14ca7878d.patch:191: +  # Single package mode: first non-flag arg (if any) is the package name.
56d14ca7878d.patch:192: +  # Remaining positional args after the first are forwarded to cargo-flux.
56d14ca7878d.patch:193: +  if [ "${#flux_args[@]}" -gt 0 ]; then
56d14ca7878d.patch:194: +    packages=("${flux_args[0]}")
56d14ca7878d.patch:195: +    flux_args=("${flux_args[@]:1}")
56d14ca7878d.patch:196: +  else
56d14ca7878d.patch:197: +    printf 'error: no package specified. Use <package>, --all, or --crates <p1> <p2> ...\n' >&2
56d14ca7878d.patch:198: +    exit 2
56d14ca7878d.patch:199: +  fi
56d14ca7878d.patch:200: +fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

if [ "$#" -lt 1 ]; then
  printf 'usage: bash scripts/flux-check-package.sh <package> [cargo-flux options]\n' >&2
  exit 2
fi

package="$1"
shift

for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --lib|--test|--tests|--benches|--all-targets)
      printf 'unsupported cargo-flux target selector for installed cargo-flux: %s\n' "$arg" >&2
      exit 2
      ;;
  esac
done

cargo flux -p "$package" --message-format human "$@"

# Own-Patch Semantic Audit Disposition v3

Corrects v2 draft errors: sequence-stamping claim, frame-pool hunk inspection, cargo-vet semantics, registry-vs-binding.

## 1. 0f71f398cf66 — Frame pool pre-allocation
**Status: PRESENT**

All hunks verified:
- `FramePool::new` pre-allocates capacity frames via loop calling `RunFrame::new` (current `crates/vb_runtime/src/frame_pool.rs:14-45`)
- `take` returns pre-allocated frame with no fresh-allocation fallback (current `:49-56`)
- `release` silently drops mismatched dimensions or over-capacity (current `:59-74`)
- Test expectations updated: `available()` starts at capacity, release returns to capacity (current `crates/vb_runtime/src/frame_pool/tests.rs:43`)

v2 correctly identified this as delivered.

## 2. 220e4d21d719 — Diagnostic test consolidation to workspace_tests
**Status: MISSING**

Patch deletes `crates/vb_core/src/diagnostic/tests_and_verification.rs` and its `#[cfg(test)] #[path]` include in `diagnostic.rs`. Current code still includes the module (current `crates/vb_core/src/diagnostic.rs:2087-2089`) and the file still exists.

```rust
// Current diagnostic.rs still has:
#[cfg(test)]
#[path = "diagnostic/tests_and_verification.rs"]
mod tests_and_verification;
```

The consolidation to `crates/workspace_tests/` was never delivered.

## 3. 56d14ca7878d — Flux Moon task and script consolidation
**Status: MISSING**

Patch adds `.moon/tasks/flux.yml`, expands `scripts/flux-check-package.sh` with `--all`/`--crates`/`--dry-run` options, and adds `flux_command` to `xtask/src/lanes.rs`. Current code has:
- No `.moon/tasks/flux.yml` (glob confirms absence)
- Old single-package-only script (current `scripts/flux-check-package.sh:1-19`)
- No `flux_command` in xtask lanes

```bash
# Current flux script is the old version:
package="$1"
shift
cargo flux -p "$package" --message-format human "$@"
```

## 4. 6351cc8cd904 — Empty [workspace.metadata.cargo-vet]
**Status: NO-OP (semantically useful only with tooling)**

Patch adds empty `[workspace.metadata.cargo-vet]` section. Current `Cargo.toml` lacks it. Empty metadata section has no semantic effect unless a tool reads it. Useful semantics: future cargo-vet tooling integration would expect this section to exist as the config anchor. Without any `.cargo-vet` config files or tooling invocation, it's a no-op addition.

## 5. a8451f741f71 — Clippy target scope narrowing
**Status: MISSING**

Patch narrows `ci` alias from `--all-targets` to `--lib --bins --examples` and removes `&` from `source.inputs()` in compile. Current code has:
- `ci` alias still uses `--all-targets` (current `.cargo/config.toml:14`)
- Compile call still uses `&source.inputs()` (in `crates/vb_compile/src/mod_compile_lowering/part_01.rs`)

## 6. bd2920512bde — Pending action index maintenance (vb-3wn7x)
**Status: PRESENT**

All hunks verified:
- `crates/vb_storage/src/batch/action_index.rs` exists with `stage_pending_action_index_op` (current line 124)
- `stage_recovery_index_ops` wrapper added (current line 103)
- `append_event` calls `stage_recovery_index_ops` (current `crates/vb_storage/src/batch/append_event.rs:105`)
- `delete_action_index` putter added to `putters.rs`

## 7. dd50c691bb67 — Verus PO-VERUS-032 registry entry
**Status: MISSING**

Patch adds PO-VERUS-032 for StepBudget::from_env to `contracts/proof_obligations.yaml`. Current file has no PO-VERUS-032 entry (grep confirms absence). This is a production-bound harness entry — binding exists in `verification/verus/signals_from_env.rs`, but the registry entry is missing.

**Note:** Distinguish binding from registry. A Verus spec can be production-bound via `#[path]` while unregistered. PO-VERUS-032 is unregistered in the current `proof_obligations.yaml`.

## 8. dec0e41e2690 — Artifact acceptance sequence tracking (GAP-007)
**Status: MISSING**

Patch adds `system` keyspace, `accept_seq_allocate`, `submit_artifact_at_seq`, and sequence-aware submission APIs. Current code:
- No `system` keyspace in `constants.rs` (grep confirms)
- No `accept_seq_allocate` method (grep confirms)
- `accepted_at_seq` still uses `EventSeq::new(0)` (current `crates/vb_storage/src/admission.rs:220`)
- Docstring still says "This field is currently always set to `EventSeq::new(0)`"

The CLI delegation change is present (`submit_cli_compiled_artifact` delegates to `vb_storage::submit_artifact`), but the sequence-aware API/body/test changes are not.

## Summary

| Patch | Status |
|-------|--------|
| 0f71f398cf66 (frame pool pre-alloc) | PRESENT |
| 220e4d21d719 (diagnostic tests) | MISSING |
| 56d14ca7878d (flux tasks) | MISSING |
| 6351cc8cd904 (cargo-vet) | NO-OP |
| a8451f741f71 (clippy scope) | MISSING |
| bd2920512bde (action index) | PRESENT |
| dd50c691bb67 (Verus PO-VERUS-032) | MISSING |
| dec0e41e2690 (acceptance seq) | MISSING |

2 delivered, 5 not delivered, 1 no-op.

56d14ca7878d.patch:63: +#   - xtask lane runner (scripts/flux-check-package.sh <package>)
56d14ca7878d.patch:64: +#   - Moon tasks (bash scripts/flux-check-package.sh <package> [--all | --crates ...])
56d14ca7878d.patch:65: +#   - Direct invocation (bash scripts/flux-check-package.sh --help | --dry-run ...)
56d14ca7878d.patch:66: +#
56d14ca7878d.patch:67: +# Usage:
56d14ca7878d.patch:68: +#   bash scripts/flux-check-package.sh <package> [cargo-flux options]
56d14ca7878d.patch:69: +#   bash scripts/flux-check-package.sh --all [cargo-flux options]
56d14ca7878d.patch:70: +#   bash scripts/flux-check-package.sh --crates <p1> <p2> ... [cargo-flux options]
56d14ca7878d.patch:71: +#   bash scripts/flux-check-package.sh --dry-run --all
56d14ca7878d.patch:72: +#   bash scripts/flux-check-package.sh --help
56d14ca7878d.patch:73: +#
56d14ca7878d.patch:74: +# The installed cargo-flux does not accept --lib, --test, --tests, --benches,
56d14ca7878d.patch:75: +# or --all-targets target selectors; these are rejected at the script level.
56d14ca7878d.patch:76: +# =============================================================================
56d14ca7878d.patch:77: +
56d14ca7878d.patch:78: +SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
56d14ca7878d.patch:79: +WORKSPACE_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)"
56d14ca7878d.patch:80: +
56d14ca7878d.patch:81: +usage() {
56d14ca7878d.patch:82: +  cat >&2 <<EOF
56d14ca7878d.patch:83: +usage: bash scripts/flux-check-package.sh [OPTIONS] [PACKAGE]
56d14ca7878d.patch:84: +
56d14ca7878d.patch:85: +Canonical flux-check entry point.
56d14ca7878d.patch:86: +
56d14ca7878d.patch:87: +Options:
56d14ca7878d.patch:88: +  --all                    Run flux on all crates with flux annotations
56d14ca7878d.patch:89: +  --crates P1 [P2 ...]    Run flux on specific packages
56d14ca7878d.patch:90: +  --dry-run               Print commands without executing
56d14ca7878d.patch:91: +  --help                  Show this help message
56d14ca7878d.patch:92: +
56d14ca7878d.patch:93: +When --all or --crates is omitted, the first positional argument is treated
56d14ca7878d.patch:94: +as the package name. Additional positional arguments are forwarded to
56d14ca7878d.patch:95: +cargo-flux.
56d14ca7878d.patch:96: +EOF
56d14ca7878d.patch:97:    exit 2
56d14ca7878d.patch:98: -fi
56d14ca7878d.patch:99: +}
56d14ca7878d.patch:100: +
56d14ca7878d.patch:101: +# --- Argument parsing ---
56d14ca7878d.patch:102: +dry_run=false
56d14ca7878d.patch:103: +run_all=false
56d14ca7878d.patch:104: +declare -a extra_packages=()
56d14ca7878d.patch:105: +declare -a flux_args=()
56d14ca7878d.patch:106: +
56d14ca7878d.patch:107: +while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do
56d14ca7878d.patch:108: +  case "$1" in
56d14ca7878d.patch:109: +    --help)
56d14ca7878d.patch:110: +      usage
56d14ca7878d.patch:111: +      ;;
56d14ca7878d.patch:112: +    --dry-run)
56d14ca7878d.patch:113: +      dry_run=true
56d14ca7878d.patch:114: +      shift
56d14ca7878d.patch:115: +      ;;
56d14ca7878d.patch:116: +    --all)
56d14ca7878d.patch:117: +      run_all=true
56d14ca7878d.patch:118: +      shift
56d14ca7878d.patch:119: +      ;;
56d14ca7878d.patch:120: +    --crates)
56d14ca7878d.patch:121: +      shift
56d14ca7878d.patch:122: +      if [ "$#" -lt 1 ]; then
56d14ca7878d.patch:123: +        printf 'error: --crates requires at least one package name\n' >&2
56d14ca7878d.patch:124: +        exit 2
56d14ca7878d.patch:125: +      fi
56d14ca7878d.patch:126: +      while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do
56d14ca7878d.patch:127: +        case "$1" in
56d14ca7878d.patch:128: +          --dry-run|--all|--crates|--help)
56d14ca7878d.patch:129: +            break
56d14ca7878d.patch:130: +            ;;
56d14ca7878d.patch:131: +          *)
56d14ca7878d.patch:132: +            extra_packages+=("$1")
56d14ca7878d.patch:133: +            shift
56d14ca7878d.patch:134: +            ;;
56d14ca7878d.patch:135: +        esac
56d14ca7878d.patch:136: +      done
56d14ca7878d.patch:137: +      ;;
56d14ca7878d.patch:138: +    *)
56d14ca7878d.patch:139: +      flux_args+=("$1")
56d14ca7878d.patch:140: +      shift
56d14ca7878d.patch:141: +      ;;
56d14ca7878d.patch:142: +  esac
56d14ca7878d.patch:143: +done
56d14ca7878d.patch:144:  
56d14ca7878d.patch:145: -package="$1"
56d14ca7878d.patch:146: -shift
56d14ca7878d.patch:147: +# --- Target-selector validation ---
56d14ca7878d.patch:148: +# The installed cargo-flux does not accept these flags.
56d14ca7878d.patch:149: +reject_target_selector() {
56d14ca7878d.patch:150: +  printf 'unsupported cargo-flux target selector: %s\n' "$1" >&2
56d14ca7878d.patch:151: +  exit 2
56d14ca7878d.patch:152: +}
56d14ca7878d.patch:153:  
56d14ca7878d.patch:154: -for arg in "$@"; do
56d14ca7878d.patch:155: +for arg in "${flux_args[@]+"${flux_args[@]}"}"; do
56d14ca7878d.patch:156:    case "$arg" in
56d14ca7878d.patch:157:      --lib|--test|--tests|--benches|--all-targets)
56d14ca7878d.patch:158: -      printf 'unsupported cargo-flux target selector for installed cargo-flux: %s\n' "$arg" >&2
56d14ca7878d.patch:159: -      exit 2
56d14ca7878d.patch:160: +      reject_target_selector "$arg"
56d14ca7878d.patch:161:        ;;
56d14ca7878d.patch:162:    esac
56d14ca7878d.patch:163:  done
56d14ca7878d.patch:164:  
56d14ca7878d.patch:165: -cargo flux -p "$package" --message-format human "$@"
56d14ca7878d.patch:166: +# --- Discover packages ---
56d14ca7878d.patch:167: +discover_all_flux_crates() {
56d14ca7878d.patch:168: +  # Find crates with #[cfg(flux)] gated flux source files.
56d14ca7878d.patch:169: +  # This avoids running flux on every crate when only a subset has annotations.
56d14ca7878d.patch:170: +  local found=()
56d14ca7878d.patch:171: +  for manifest in "$WORKSPACE_ROOT"/crates/*/Cargo.toml; do
56d14ca7878d.patch:172: +    local crate_name
56d14ca7878d.patch:173: +    crate_name="$(basename "$(dirname "$manifest")")"
56d14ca7878d.patch:174: +    # Check if the crate has flux-annotated source files
56d14ca7878d.patch:175: +    local crate_src="$WORKSPACE_ROOT/crates/$crate_name/src"
56d14ca7878d.patch:176: +    if [ -d "$crate_src" ] && grep -rl '#\[cfg(flux)\]' "$crate_src" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
56d14ca7878d.patch:177: +      found+=("$crate_name")
56d14ca7878d.patch:178: +    fi
56d14ca7878d.patch:179: +  done
56d14ca7878d.patch:180: +  printf '%s\n' "${found[@]+"${found[@]}"}"
56d14ca7878d.patch:181: +}
56d14ca7878d.patch:182: +
56d14ca7878d.patch:183: +if $run_all; then
56d14ca7878d.patch:184: +  declare -a packages=()
56d14ca7878d.patch:185: +  while IFS= read -r pkg; do
56d14ca7878d.patch:186: +    [ -n "$pkg" ] && packages+=("$pkg")
56d14ca7878d.patch:187: +  done < <(discover_all_flux_crates)
56d14ca7878d.patch:188: +elif [ "${#extra_packages[@]}" -gt 0 ]; then
56d14ca7878d.patch:189: +  packages=("${extra_packages[@]}")
56d14ca7878d.patch:190: +else
56d14ca7878d.patch:191: +  # Single package mode: first non-flag arg (if any) is the package name.
56d14ca7878d.patch:192: +  # Remaining positional args after the first are forwarded to cargo-flux.
56d14ca7878d.patch:193: +  if [ "${#flux_args[@]}" -gt 0 ]; then
56d14ca7878d.patch:194: +    packages=("${flux_args[0]}")
56d14ca7878d.patch:195: +    flux_args=("${flux_args[@]:1}")
56d14ca7878d.patch:196: +  else
56d14ca7878d.patch:197: +    printf 'error: no package specified. Use <package>, --all, or --crates <p1> <p2> ...\n' >&2
56d14ca7878d.patch:198: +    exit 2
56d14ca7878d.patch:199: +  fi
56d14ca7878d.patch:200: +fi
